newsitem.title: USA: LG&E Energy enters Big Rivers pact.
newsitem.headline: LG&E Energy enters Big Rivers pact.

text.p: LG&E Energy Corp and Big Rivers Electric Corp said they reached a global settlement agreement on all outstanding issues regarding LG&E Energy's 25-year lease of Big Rivers 1,700 megawatts of generation capacity in Western Kentucky.

Federal Bankruptcy Judge Wendell Roberts approved the disclosure statement and confirmed a June 9 hearing date for the reorganization of Big Rivers, an electricity cooperative, LG&E and Big Rivers said in a joint statement.
LG&E and Big Rivers said the majority of creditors support their plan over a proposal from PacifiCorp.

If the creditors vote to approve the plan of reorganization on June 9, the closing of the LG&E Energy transaction will be subject only to regulatory approval by the Kentucky Public Service Commission and the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, the companies said.
LG&E Energy also will enter into an interim power marketing agreement with Big Rivers for the company's excess generating capacity effective mid-June 1997, the companies said.
This agreement will provide for the sale of an average of 200,000 megawatts of electricity per month between mid-June and the closing date of the transaction, the companies said.
Once regulatory approvals are achieved, the two companies will have a permanent power marketing agreement.
